sections.title: Player-facing description
sections.body: A smooth grey pebble feels warm and ordinary until it refuses to stay where you put it. Set it down, look away, and it waits back in your palm.

sections.title: Public role
sections.body: Recall Stone: place it anywhere, set a trigger, and it teleports back to your hand when the trigger happens.

sections.title: Handout text
sections.body: GOLDWATER RECALL ASSURANCE: Why carry an unregistered stone when you could lease ours, with quarterly recall fees and a Recall Recall Clause?

sections.title: GM truth
sections.body: No forced reveal. Let this entity disclose truth through scene context and player attention.

sections.title: GM handling
sections.body: Use when the scene needs a concrete object for players to inspect, carry, debate, or remember.
